title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩图快照并利用图自编码器重构误差训练节点表征，结合循环神经网络学习时间维度依赖，高效生成动态图的高质量低维表征。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose GSAERU, a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method based on graph summarization, which compresses graph snapshots via graph summarization and trains node representations using a graph autoencoder with reconstruction error, then employs a recurrent neural network to learn temporal dependencies, efficiently generating high-quality low-dimensional representations for dynamic graphs.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
采用图摘要技术对单时间步图快照进行压缩
将压缩后的图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
使用循环神经网络学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each time step
Compress graph snapshots at each time step using graph summarization technology
Feed compressed graphs into a graph autoencoder and train original node representations with reconstruction error against the original graph
Use a recurrent neural network to learn temporal features and dependencies of the original graph
source_locations: 论文摘要及正文中关于GSAERU模型描述部分

novelty_points.claim: 提出基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法 DSGNN，采用“领导者-工作者”模式，通过基于边分割的图流划分算法划分大规模图数据，工作节点执行基于图摘要的小批量训练，并通过注意力层将训练结果返回领导节点，最终由领导节点汇总计算梯度并同步更新所有计算节点模型，从而加速大规模图上的 GNN 训练并提升链路预测性能。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose DSGNN, a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm based on graph summarization, which adopts leader-worker mode, partitions large-scale graph data using an edge-based graph stream partitioning algorithm, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization and return results through an attention layer, and the leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes, thereby accelerating GNN training on large-scale graphs and improving link prediction performance.
technical_features: 采用“领导者-工作者”分布式训练模式
领导节点使用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分并分配给工作节点
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点的模型
technical_features_en: Leader partitions the original graph using an edge-based graph stream partitioning algorithm and assigns subgraphs to workers
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
Leader aggregates results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
source_locations: 论文摘要及正文中关于DSGNN模型描述部分

novelty_points.claim: 提出一种基于边分割的图流划分算法，用于大规模图流数据场景下将原图划分为多个子图，分配给多个工作节点以实现分布式图神经网络训练，从而克服图数据不规则性带来的训练挑战。
novelty_points.claim_en: Propose an edge-based graph stream partitioning algorithm to partition the original graph into subgraphs for multiple workers in large-scale graph streaming scenarios, enabling distributed graph neural network training and overcoming the challenges caused by irregularity of graph data.
technical_features: 基于边分割的图流划分算法
将原图划分为多个子图
technical_features_en: Partition the original graph into subgraphs
source_locations: 论文摘要及正文中关于DSGNN模型描述部分
